scenario_description:
Objective: Capture a same-day no-cost AquaHome counter mat for the compact dishwasher, without changing warranty coverage or buying supplies.
Emerging Need: A vague owner-day teaser becomes useful only after eligibility terms, pickup feasibility, and the required in-store kit code align.
Decision Context: The saved warranty note holds the serial, receipt label, support route, and no-paid-plan constraint needed to distinguish a free reservation from accessory shopping.
Consequence: Timely use could add a modest household convenience; ignoring it leaves the appliance, warranty, and spending unchanged, and after reservations close the benefit is unavailable.

parameter.subject: AquaHome owner-day accessories at Midtown today
parameter.body: AquaHome will have a small owner-day counter at Midtown this afternoon. Some compact-dishwasher accessories may be free for qualifying recent owners; item list and reservation terms will be posted later today. Paid bundles will also be on display.

parameter.title: Pick up altered scrub jacket near Midtown
parameter.description: Pickup counter is two doors from Midtown Home Goods; bring claim slip.

parameter.subject: Today only: no-cost counter mat for qualifying AquaHome compact owners
parameter.body: For today's Midtown owner-day, recent AquaHome compact-dishwasher owners with a Midtown Home Goods receipt may reserve one no-cost counter-protection mat. Reservation emails must arrive by 2:30 PM and include the registered serial, Midtown receipt label, and the kit code posted at the demo table. Reserved mats may be picked up at Midtown between 3:00 PM and 6:00 PM. No purchase or plan enrollment is required.

parameter.content: I'm at Midtown now and the AquaHome table sign says today's free mat kit code is MHG-MAT-SILVER. Staff said reserved names can pick up until 6, but they are not taking walk-up holds by text.

parameter.subject: AquaHome owner-day reservation queue is closed
parameter.body: The Midtown owner-day reservation queue closed at 2:30 PM. All remaining no-cost counter mats have been assigned to names already on the reservation list, and no after-hours hold list will be opened for today's stock.
